`Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N40_00_W074_00_DEM-block7.tif` is cut from the Copernicus GLO-30 file of the
degree square N40 W074 (AWS open data, `s3://copernicus-dem-30m`, fetched 2026-11-06): its own header,
its own block 7 (Long Island's south shore and Fire Island) and its own all-sea block 9 standing in
for every other block. It tests that the height map reads Copernicus's real bytes (ROADMAP 37b-ii).
